name: Resonant Sentinel
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
description: A Resonant Sentinel is a solemn ward-construct forged to guard Numillian's sealed passages, its body shaped from pale stone, lacquered brass, and latticed crystal set with faintly glowing rune-lines. It stands taller than a human, broad-shouldered and statuesque, with a featureless helm-like face that holds a single circular aperture where a lens of blue-white light slowly turns, listening. Thin chimes hang from its joints and along its back like ceremonial scales, and with every measured step they give off a low, harmonic tone that seems to ripple through the air and stir dust from the floor. When still, it resembles an ornate monument; when roused, the runes across its chest and arms brighten in pulsing rings, as if answering an unseen command. It moves with ritual precision, never wasting motion, raising shield and spear in perfect alignment with the ward-lines around it. In battle, its resonant hum deepens into a warning drone that vibrates stone, glass, and bone alike, making nearby lantern flames tremble. It feels less like a machine than a living bell given purpose: patient, unblinking, and utterly devoted to the sanctity of the threshold it guards.
